title: HADA: Human-AI Agent Decision Alignment Architecture
V89_REASON: Peer-reviewed HADA implementation wraps a production credit-scoring model; objectives/KPIs/value constraints are continuously propagated, logged and versioned, and scripted scenarios demonstrate bias detection/mitigation, lineage, audit and contestability. However, the evidence describes stakeholder steering/control around decisions rather than an explicit exact-action pre-dispatch admission/revalidation gate, so CORE_REVIEW remains appropriate.

title: Automated Power Dispatch Architecture Based on Multi-Agent Collaboration
V89_REASON: DMAC-PD includes a Safety Agent enforcing physical and power-stability constraints and end-to-end automation from task analysis through strategy generation. Available evidence terminates at dispatch-strategy generation and computation-tool invocation; it does not demonstrate live grid switching/dispatch commitment. Therefore it is adjacent mechanism evidence, not CORE.

title: An Agentic Framework for Aerial Swarms: Integrating LLMs with the Crazyswarm2
V89_REASON: Web-of-Drones framework performs continuous state observation, grounded tool interaction and safe actuation with runtime guardrails, but the published evaluation is ArduPilot-based simulation. It is strong embodied execution evidence without a demonstrated real-world consequential commit, so ADJACENT.

title: SPAR: Scalable Prioritized Agent Routing for Multi-agent Networks
V89_REASON: Fault-recovery MCP framework experimentally verifies topology, transformer/bus/feeder queries and power-flow calculation for recovery-plan generation. No autonomous restoration switching or live distribution-network commit is demonstrated.

title: GenHAPI: Conversational Orchestration over MCP to Unlock Complex Legacy Workflows
V89_REASON: GenHAPI is explicitly a chat-to-action orchestration layer over MCP for complex legacy enterprise workflows, but public abstract/program evidence does not expose action classes, authorization semantics, or pre-commit validation. Insufficient evidence to resolve safely.

title: Autonomous Reliability Engineering: A Scalable Agentic AI Framework for Enterprise Infrastructure Support
V89_REASON: Autonomous Reliability Engineering is confirmed as a SoutheastCon 2026 paper, but accessible public sources still do not expose remediation actions, authorization gates, or post-action verification. Keep pending.

title: Intelligent Automation of Network Security Operations via Intention-Driven Agents and Large Language Models
V89_REASON: Network-security-operations paper is confirmed, but no accessible method/full-text evidence establishes whether intention-driven agents autonomously execute remediation or validate authority/state before commit.

title: Bridging Real and Virtual Worlds: A Blockchain-IoT-Agent Framework for the Metaverse
V89_REASON: Blockchain-IoT-agent framework is confirmed as a primary MetaCom paper bridging real and virtual systems, but accessible sources do not establish agent action semantics or runtime validity checks.

title: AI-Enhanced Management and Control (MC) Architecture for Multi-Layer and Multi-Domain Optical Networks
V89_REASON: Optical-network architecture uses LLMs, A2A task orchestration and MCP tool invocation for multi-layer/multi-domain management and control, but available summary does not establish actual live configuration commits or an explicit pre-commit revalidation mechanism.
